questions.implements: Does the diff implement what the repository records for the Jira issue, and add or change a test that checks it? Judge the code in the diff, not the answer.

judge.reason: The diff does implement R-VOLUME-DISCOUNT. In `price`, any line with 10 or more units gets 5% off, worked out per line with Math.floor (rounded down to the cent). The code discount is then applied to the subtotal minus the volume discount, so the volume discount comes first. The volume and code discounts are added together and capped at floor(50% of the subtotal), which means the volume discount counts toward the cap. Checkout now passes the cart lines to `price`. The new tests check each rule. The per-line test (19×10 → 9 each, 101×9 not eligible) checks the 10-unit threshold, rounding down and the volume-then-code order, and its expected values work out to 1,289 / 145. The cap test (209 subtotal, 100% code → 104 discount) checks the combined cap. A checkout-level test also checks the volume-discounted total of 10,000 / 500.

finalMessage:
Implemented SHOP-57. Checkout now applies a 5% discount to each cart line with at least 10 units, rounds each line down to the cent, applies any discount code afterward, and caps the combined discount at 50% of the original subtotal. I linked the code and tests in [REQUIREMENTS.md](/private/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.rules.ts-shop.T5.2/repo/REQUIREMENTS.md:69).

**Verification:** `npm test` passed all 39 tests, including the three new SHOP-57 tests. The changed code keeps R-VOLUME-DISCOUNT, R-TAX-RATE, R-CHECKOUT-ORDER, and R-CHECKOUT-SESSION true. Their listed tests passed: the three volume discount tests, `price > taxes the subtotal after discounts`, `tax > rounds half up to the cent`, `Checkout > places an order`, and `Checkout > needs a valid session`. No risk or threat control entry is linked to the changed code.

**Requirement conflict to review:** R-DISCOUNT-PERCENT says a code takes its percentage off “the subtotal.” With SHOP-57, the code applies to the amount *after* the volume discount, so that entry is no longer literally true for eligible carts. I left its wording unchanged.
